description.zh:
Bucket读写权限类型：

- **public-read-write**：公共读写

- **public-read**：公共读

- **private**：私有（默认值）
description.en:
The access control list (ACL) of the bucket.

- **public-read-write**

- **public-read**

- **private** (default)

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ens put-bucket-acl --bucket-name test --bucket-acl private --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ens PutBucketAcl --region cn-hangzhou --BucketAcl private --BucketName test
